name: Canvas UI
tagline: Creative html-in-canvas and WebGL effects, framework agnostic
description: 33 components that render live HTML through canvas and WebGL: Blaze, Liquid, Glass, Shatter, Particle Reveal, VHS. Each one ships in React, Solid, Preact, Vue, Svelte and dependency-free vanilla TypeScript from the same engine, and falls back to a pure WebGL overlay in browsers without the experimental html-in-canvas capability.
